title: Turns Tasty Pack reference material into a routed asset plan
query: A Tasty Pack reference shows a 20s vertical product teaser with a fast hook, AI product b-roll, kinetic captions, a presenter voiceover, and three punchy SFX hits. Create the asset plan for Remotion execution.
reference_points: Decomposes footage, stills, captions, voiceover, SFX, and final composition
Routes stills, video clips, avatar/audio, and Remotion separately
Includes acceptance checks for each asset
anti_patterns: Creates one generic generation prompt instead of an asset inventory
Copies the reference without rights or likeness notes
Hands Remotion a vague mood board without assets, timing, or checks

title: Builds a missing-asset inventory from a storyboard
query: A storyboard has five scenes, but only the logo and product screenshot exist. Build a missing-asset inventory.
reference_points: Marks missing visuals and audio for generation or sourcing
